dialogues.speaker: Grandmaster Hanakado
dialogues.text: Oh, you're still here? Looks like your passion for beetle fighting has fully blossomed...

choices.text: About your beetle fight with Itto...

response.speaker: Grandmaster Hanakado
response.text: Haha, you guys pick up fast! Let me give you a recap of the highlights of all the fights I've had with the Bona-Fide Beetle Battle King...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh right, didn't you and Bull-Chucker... Ahem! Didn't you and Bona-Fide Beetle Battle King continue the battle on your home ground?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: How did you sneak back here alone? Did he finally best you?

response.speaker: Grandmaster Hanakado
response.text: Aha! Did you think it was that easy to beat me?

response.speaker: Grandmaster Hanakado
response.text: When I arrived, Bona-Fide Beetle Battle King had met my grandfather and took a keen interest in how he took care of his Onikabuto.

response.speaker: Grandmaster Hanakado
response.text: He was chatting eagerly with my grandfather, discussing the beetles' diet and training grounds, and it looked like the conversation was going to take quite a while.

response.speaker: Grandmaster Hanakado
response.text: Letting Bona-Fide Beetle Battle King and his Crimson Staff take a break helps to make our next battle a fair fight, so I came back here to take a look.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Well... Paimon kind of gets it. The place you mentioned is your home, and your awesome Onikabuto— they're all taken care of by your grandfather, so they're big and strong, right?

response.speaker: Grandmaster Hanakado
response.text: Yeah, that's about it! But there's more to my game than that, like a little secret that affects the habits of the beetles...

response.speaker: Grandmaster Hanakado
response.text: Come and have a look if you have the chance!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: A secret, huh? Now Paimon really wants to know what it's all about! Paimon promises to drop by next time!

response.speaker: Grandmaster Hanakado
response.text: We'll meet again, Oni King's Right Hand and Skycleaving White-Iron Lavender Melon!
